message: No detected input validation: The code defines argparse arguments with types and defaults but performs no explicit schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data files or parsed arguments (e.g., no validation that val_size is within [0,1], no file existence checks, no data structure validation).

No detected untrusted source handling: There is no code that fetches data from any remote source, and no checksum verification, signed URL handling, or pinned revision logic is present anywhere in the provided snippet.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only checks for unlabeled data ratio and multi-class ratios as informational warnings, but performs no validation against an expected label set or label-noise/flipping detection.

No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples to defend against data poisoning in any of the code files shown.

No detected model integrity verification: No hash checks, signature verification, or pinned model revision controls are visible in any of the code snippets when loading pretrained weights or serialized models.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense is present in the visible code.
No detected differential privacy: There is no use of Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any other differential privacy mechanism in the visible training code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no adversarial attack simulation, robustness testing library usage (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD), or any stress-test logic anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While separate train/val/test file arguments exist, there is no signing, hashing, or isolation enforcement of the test set, and no mechanism to detect or prevent metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path (linear_test and related functions) accepts datasets and config directly without any shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks are applied to model outputs before they are returned or logged in the visible inference code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a multi-label classification pipeline, not an LLM text-in/text-out system, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
